notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence medium): MSUI realizes the AccountLogin glue: the UI_MainMenu burning-gate scene rendered through the model's own authored camera/fog/light rig (GlueScene), account/password edit boxes with AccountLogin.xml-derived insets, the Remember Account Name checkbox, and the riveted GlueDialog logon-progress dialogs with the 1.12 captions (Connecting / Authentication Successful / Entering World) and a Cancel that stops the session. The credential retry path is explicitly hardened: a refused password cleanly resets the worker so a re-typed submit works (the documented RETRY BUG fix), matching Benilla's never-auto-retry-a-refusal policy.
